WIND/TARGET robustness only (nominal build+motor). Robustness to build/motor/timing dispersion is separate — see montecarlo.py.
3-D render of the TRUE rocket (attitude from the logged quaternion). Gray marker = EKF position belief. The 4 blue margin fins fold out with deploy (folded flat=stable, 90° out=destabilizing; a differential fold does roll); the 3 green legs swing out at ignition; the gimballed exhaust shows the TVC deflection. Drag the scene to orbit; wheel to zoom. Playback 1.0x = real time.
